metadata.description: Verifies correct vs incorrect API signatures and parameters by running actual MATLAB commands

results.assertion: wdenoise2 valid methods: SURE, Bayes, Minimax, UniversalThreshold, FDR
BlockJS is NOT a valid DenoisingMethod for wdenoise2
results.incorrect_result: ERROR: Expected DENOISINGMETHOD to match one of these values: 'UniversalThreshold', 'Minimax', 'SURE', 'Bayes', 'FDR'. The input, 'BlockJS', did not match any of the valid values.

results.assertion: dldwt returns exactly 2 outputs [A, D], not 4
results.correct_result: success — A is dlarray [4x4], D is dlarray [4x4x3] (H/V/D subbands stacked)
results.notes: D is a single 3D dlarray with subbands stacked in 3rd dimension, NOT a cell array

results.assertion: dldwt D output is a dlarray, not a cell array
results.result: D class = dlarray, iscell(D) = false, size = [4 4 3]

results.assertion: dldwt requires SSCB or CBT format dlarray (not SS)
results.incorrect_result: ERROR: Input must be a 'CBT' or 'SSCB' dlarray.

results.assertion: detcoef2 accepts ('h'|'v'|'d', C, S, level) syntax
detcoef2 does NOT accept compact write-back with extra arguments
results.incorrect_command: detcoef2('compact', C, S, 1, h, v, d)

results.assertion: negloglik is a function (not a property) of fitted distributions
.NegLogLikelihood property does NOT exist on fitted distributions
results.incorrect_result: ERROR: Unrecognized method, property, or field 'NegLogLikelihood' for class 'prob.NormalDistribution'.

results.assertion: unet returns dlnetwork (not LayerGraph)
unet3d returns dlnetwork
unetLayers returns LayerGraph (old deprecated API)
results.notes: Warning: unetLayers will be removed in a future release. Use the unet function instead.

results.assertion: imagePretrainedNetwork returns dlnetwork
deeplabv3plus exists and takes (inputSize, numClasses, backbone) syntax
results.notes: Requires ResNet18 support package for pretrained weights; works with imagePretrainedNetwork(...,Weights='none')

results.assertion: volshow supports OverlayData parameter for label overlays
labelvolshow has been REMOVED and errors on invocation
results.result: ERROR: labelvolshow has been removed. With appropriate code changes, use 'volshow' instead.
results.notes: which() still locates the .m file but the function body throws a removal error

results.assertion: radiomics object API: create then call feature methods
results.result: success — radiomics object created, intensityFeatures returns table [1x50], shapeFeatures returns table [1x24]

results.assertion: shearletSystem + sheart2 + isheart2 workflow
results.command: sls = shearletSystem('ImageSize',[64 64]); coeffs = sheart2(sls, rand(64)); xr = isheart2(sls, coeffs)
results.result: success — sheart2 returns [64 64 27] coefficients, isheart2 reconstructs [64 64] with error ~9.5e-15

results.assertion: shearletTransform function does NOT exist
intrinsicToWorld returns 3 separate arrays [X, Y, Z]
fillmissing supports 'knn' method in base MATLAB
results.notes: No additional toolbox required (base MATLAB datafun)

results.assertion: coxphfit works for Cox proportional hazards regression
results.result: success — returns [b, logl, H, stats] with fields: covb, beta, se, z, p, csres, devres, martres, schres, sschres, scores, sscores, LikelihoodRatioTestP

results.assertion: unet default NumFirstEncoderFilters = 64
unet accepts explicit NumFirstEncoderFilters parameter
results.result: success — first conv layer has NumFilters = 32

results.assertion: segmentObjectsFromEmbeddings requires imageSize parameter
results.result: Syntax: masks = segmentObjectsFromEmbeddings(sam, embeddings, imageSize, ForegroundPoints=pointPrompt)
results.notes: imageSize is the 3rd required positional argument
